positive_evidence: Candidate-specific player feedback repeatedly praises a fast movement system built around jumping, diving, wall-running and frequent weapon switching.
The pinned profile treats expressive movement as an independently strong source of enjoyment and specifically values wall-running, fast traversal and mastery.
A late-game difficulty spike is a risk, but the profile does not penalize difficulty by itself when the core movement/combat loop remains skill-based.
